title: Reject unmatched parentheses before selecting an active profile
summary: Malformed profile expressions now fail during construction. A context with the malformed annotation also failed, while its valid twin supplied the requested bean.

change.description: Profiles.of now rejects an unmatched closing or opening parenthesis during parsing. An application can otherwise enable a component from an invalid profile declaration.

notes: The parent matched both malformed expressions and activated the malformed bean. The valid conjunction changed truth when prod became active on both revisions.
